future_P6_preserved_paused: Future maximize prespecified R(A), subject F(A)>=F(A0)-delta and C(A)<=B; persona-preserving A0 (not automatically C0), prespecified scales/margins and uncertainty or Pareto comparisons. No P6 work authorized now.

measurement.AI: Separate item-level proposals with evidence, alternative and uncertainty. Human fields blank. Initial condition-masked scoring; response cues may reveal treatments.
measurement.agreement: Exact metric-specific paired comparable judgments; categorical confusion, missingness, coverage and discordances. Shared references mean agreement is not independent accuracy.
measurement.automatic: Conservative typed-value/slot checks; unknown scope and unsupported free text remain flagged. Never infer full factual truth from token presence alone.
measurement.behavioral_fidelity: 1 opposite ordering, 2 largely contrary, 3 mixed, 4 mostly aligned, 5 target answer/acknowledgment ordering. No opportunity if only an answer or only acknowledgment; absence is not forced low score.
measurement.boundary: Preserve raw response_status_v1. Separate eos/eog-compatible boundary view and item-level first-answer proposal. No automatic factual penalty for budget/cross-turn. Do not invent a reply from unresolved spans.
measurement.completeness: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN/MISSING for requested answer delivery, independent of truth; a complete wrong answer can be YES.
measurement.coverage: Report delivered components and supported components separately with exact source witnesses.
measurement.factual: Audit each material assertion against evidence and scope. Correct/Incorrect/Unverifiable/N/A/Missing. Partial correct claims can be Correct with task failure.
measurement.linguistic_fidelity: 1 incompatible, 2 mostly incompatible, 3 mixed, 4 mostly aligned, 5 all observable target features aligned; not factual accuracy or prompt similarity.

relevance.5: Directly addresses requested task without digression

measurement.task: All requested components delivered correctly with required date/relationship attachments. Success/Failure/Uncertain/Missing.
measurement.temporal: Date-validity of claims, including valid historical assertions. Unknown date attachment is interpretation uncertainty, not automatic Incorrect.

primary_comparison.definition: Affirmatively assign the prospectively listed old bay to the target entity for 2051-09-15. A quoted, negated or correctly dated historical value alone is not adoption.
primary_comparison.denominator: All eight prospectively eligible paired cases, including unknown outputs; report adoption/8 per condition, observed positive-incidence difference and signed unknown-outcome bounds.
primary_comparison.insufficient: Fewer than six paired assessable cases is measurement-inconclusive. Eight cases remain too few for population inference regardless.
primary_comparison.interpretation: Implemented history package, not pure temporal reasoning. Old-value historical correctness is preserved.
primary_comparison.name: C3-C0
primary_comparison.nonanswer: A clear refusal/nonanswer with no old-answer assertion is NOT_ADOPTED, separately a task failure; unclear claims are UNVERIFIABLE.

protocol: Research Protocol v1.1 retained; v1.2 remains proposed; adopted E/V addendum not replaced

readiness.old_proposal: The unexecuted core_sfh_readiness_v1 eight-of-eight criterion is not this new calibration rule; preserve its historical proposal.
readiness.pilot_rule: Inspect disjoint calibration by family. Do not discard difficult cases, select pilot cases by their C0 outcome, or tune to the target. Serious floor/format/scoring defects require category C diagnosis or stop.

statistics.missingness: Full assigned denominators plus assessable subset separately; signed bounds for unknown binary outcomes; no renormalized missing factorial weights.
statistics.multiplicity: One principal developmental endpoint. All other results descriptive; no significance testing or discovery selection.
statistics.uncertainty: C0 Wilson 95% interval descriptive under independent Bernoulli approximation, with family/template limitations; whole-speaker bootstrap sensitivity for paired pilot outcomes, no significance claims.
statistics.units: 32 disjoint C0 cases/speakers; eight factorial paired cases/speakers; four shared template ancestors across pools
statistics.variance: Applicable, N/A, missing, unknown, categorical distributions; numerical variance only on justified scored scales; no zero-variance equals zero-effect claim.
